_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Oli mukino Klondike Solitaire. Eriyo lyo ni kulongoose kaadi zonna ku foundation piles.

Emirimu gy'Omukino:
- Foundation piles (F1-F4): Zimba okuva Ace okutuuka King mu suit
- Tableau piles (T1-T7): Zimba okuva wansi ng'erinnya ly'ekika kikiriranye (ekika ekyo ku kiragala, kiragala ku kyo)
- Stock: Longoose kaadi ku waste pile
- Waste (W): Kaadi ya juu esobole okukolera

Okuyita:
- 'draw' - Longoose kaadi okuva stock ku waste
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Longoose kaadi wakati wa piles
  Amatenderezo: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count ayinza kuba 'all', ekitegeza kulongoose kaadi zonna eziri waggulu.
- 'forfeit' - Komola omukino butereevu n'ekitandise ekyo kya sika
- Amannya g'ebijanja: W (waste), F1-F4 (foundations), T1-T7 (tableau)

Oyinza kukola ebikolwa bingi mu kiseera kimo nga obikolera wakati wa commas:
  Ekyokulabirako: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Kings pekee ndizo zisobola kuwekwa ku bijanja ebiriko bya tableau.
Ebibikolwa bikolera mu mpangula - singa kimu kikyuka, ebibikolwa ebisigadde biyitibwa.
Yita 'forfeit' bwekiri okukkiriza nti omukino tegusobola kuguwangula.

format_error.no_brackets: Enkola ya kikolwa si nnungi. Ekikolwa kirina okubeera mu buwangwa (brackets).
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Enkola ya kikolwa etagasa. Okuggulawo kwa ']' tekuliiwo"
format_error.move_needs_args: Okuyita kwa move kyeetaaga source na destination. Enkozesa: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_invalid: Count si sahihi. Yita nambari oba 'all'

action_result.before_failure: Kuteekebwako {n} kikolwa oba bikolwa kabla ya kutawanyika.

move_result.drew: Baawangudde kaadi okuva ku bintu ne bifuuka kasasiro.
move_result.cannot_draw: Tetusobola kusika. Byonna ebiri mu buwunga n'ebisasiro tebirina kintu kyonna.
move_result.invalid_pile: Erinnya ly'ekibinja ekitali kituufu. Kozesa W, F1-F4, oba T1-T7
move_result.foundation_one_card: Asobola okusengula kaadi emu yokka ku musingi.
move_result.waste_to_foundation_ok: Kaadi eyasengulwa okuva mu kasasiro okudda ku musingi F{dst}
move_result.waste_to_foundation_bad: Temuyinza kusengula kaadi y'ebisasiro ku kibinja ky'omusingi ekyo
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_ok: Ilifua kadi kutoka kwenye tableau T{src} hadi msingi F{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_foundation_bad: Temuyinza kusengula kaadi ya tableau ku kibinja ekyo eky'omusingi
move_result.foundation_to_foundation: Tayinza kusenguka okuva ku musingi okudda mu musingi omulala.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_one_card: Asobola okusengula kaadi emu yokka okuva mu kasasiro okudda ku kipande.
move_result.waste_to_tableau_ok: Kaadi esindikiddwa okuva mu kasasiro okudda ku kipande T{dst}
move_result.waste_to_tableau_bad: Temuyinza kuteeka kaadi y'ebisasiro ku kibinja ekyo eky'ebipande
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_ok: Ilifua {count} kadi(s) kutoka kwenye tableau T{src} hadi T{dst}
move_result.tableau_to_tableau_bad: Haiwezi kusogea {count} kadi(s) kutoka T{src} hadi T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_one_card: Asobola okusengula kaadi emu yokka okuva ku musingi okutuuka mu kipande.
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_ok: Kadhi kagiddwa ku F{src} akafuluma akasogezwa ku T{dst}
move_result.foundation_to_tableau_bad: Temuyinza kuteeka kaadi y'omusingi ku kipande T{dst}
move_result.to_waste_or_stock: Tetusobola kutwalibwa mu kasasiro oba ku bugagga.

outcome.forfeit: Omupiira gwaggwa. Empaka ez'enkomerero: {score} kaadi mu misingi.
outcome.turn_limit: Mchezo umemaliza! Umeifikia kiwango cha juu cha {max_turns} mudumu. Alama: {score} kadi kwenye misingi.
